# muxt check handles a template that renders itself with the same dot type
# (a tree), and reports an error inside it exactly once.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check
stdout 'ok:'

cp bad-template.gohtml template.gohtml
! muxt check
stderr -count=1 'field or method Missing not found'

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<html><body>{{template "node" .Result}}</body></html>{{end}}

{{define "node"}}<li>{{.Name}}<ul>{{range .Children}}{{template "node" .}}{{end}}</ul></li>{{end}}
-- bad-template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<html><body>{{template "node" .Result}}</body></html>{{end}}

{{define "node"}}<li>{{.Missing}}<ul>{{range .Children}}{{template "node" .}}{{end}}</ul></li>{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "template.gohtml"))

type Node struct {
	Name     string
	Children []Node
}

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() Node {
	return Node{Name: "root", Children: []Node{{Name: "leaf"}}}
}
